parameters.query: INSERT INTO user_sessions_leads (tg_user_id, tg_username, client_name, distributor_id, current_step, selected_sku) VALUES ({{ $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.message ? $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.message?.from?.id : $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.callback_query?.from?.id }}, '{{ ($('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.message ? $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.message?.from?.username : $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.callback_query?.from?.username) || '' }}', '{{ ($('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.message ? $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.message?.from?.first_name : $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.callback_query?.from?.first_name) || 'Менеджер' }}', {{ $env.DEFAULT_DISTRIBUTOR_ID || 1 }}, 'MANAGER_MODE', '551000') ON CONFLICT (tg_user_id) DO UPDATE SET tg_username = EXCLUDED.tg_username, client_name = EXCLUDED.client_name, current_step = 'MANAGER_MODE' RETURNING *;

parameters.query: UPDATE user_sessions_leads SET selected_sku = '{{ $json.sku }}', selected_bundle = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.items || $json.raw_payload) }}'::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tg_user_id = {{ $json.tg_user_id }} RETURNING *;

parameters.text: ={{ '✅ Выбран диспенсер для примерки: ' + '' + $('Parse Selected Dispenser').first().json.name + ' ' + '• Артикул: ' + $('Parse Selected Dispenser').first().json.sku + ' ' + '• Система: ' + $('Parse Selected Dispenser').first().json.system_code + ' ' + '• Цвет: ' + $('Parse Selected Dispenser').first().json.color_ru + ' ' + '📸 Следующий шаг: Отправьте фото стены или санузла клиента в этот чат для генерации фотомонтажа.' }}

parameters.query: SELECT u.tg_user_id, COALESCE(u.selected_sku, '551000') as selected_sku, COALESCE(p.name, 'Tork Matic® диспенсер полотенец H1') as dispenser_name, COALESCE(p.system_code, 'H1') as system_code, COALESCE(p.color, 'white') as color, COALESCE(p.dimensions_cm, '{"w": 33.7, "h": 37.2, "d": 20.6}'::jsonb) as dimensions_cm, COALESCE(p.category, 'dispenser') as category FROM user_sessions_leads u LEFT JOIN products p ON p.sku = COALESCE(u.selected_sku, '551000') WHERE u.tg_user_id = {{ $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.message ? $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.message?.from?.id : ($('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.callback_query ? $('Telegram Trigger').first()?.json?.callback_query?.from?.id : $json.tg_user_id) }};
